tagline: Leading semiconductor test solutions for AI and HPC devices
hero_kpi_rationale: Revenue related to AI and high-performance computing (HPC) is the main driver of demand for semiconductor test equipment, positioning Advantest at the heart of the current technological wave.

ai_positioning.summary: Advantest positions itself as a leader in test solutions for AI- and HPC-dedicated semiconductors, with a growing share of its business linked to these technologies. The company invests heavily in R&D to remain at the forefront.
evidence: Leadership in SoC solutions for AI/HPC

kpis.name: HPC / Cloud / AI Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by test solutions for artificial intelligence and high-performance computing chips.
kpis.description: Advantest is a leader in SoC test solutions for AI and HPC devices.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Gross Margin — gross profit divided by revenue.
kpis.description: High gross margin typical of the semiconductor equipment sector.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: High operating margin reflecting good fixed cost management.

kpis.name: R&D as % Revenue
kpis.description: Key investment to maintain technological leadership in advanced testing.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Capital Expenditures — investments in property, plant and equipment.
kpis.description: Investment in supply chain and internal production.

kpis.name: Total Employees
kpis.explanation: Headcount — total number of employees at period end.
kpis.description: Over 7,200 employees distributed globally, primarily in R&D and engineering.

kpis.name: Memory Tester Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from memory testers, Advantest's key products that verify the quality of memory chips.

kpis.name: Book-to-Bill Ratio
kpis.explanation: Ratio of orders received to sales made. Indicates whether future sales will increase or decrease.

kpis.name: HPC/Cloud Revenue
kpis.explanation: Measures revenue generated from products designed for high-performance and cloud computing servers.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Dividend Per Share — total dividends paid divided by shares outstanding.
kpis.description: Dividend per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend cut risk, monitor payout sustainability

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.explanation: Capital Return — total cash returned to shareholders (dividends + buybacks).
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 reported fiscal years.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Payout Ratio — dividends paid divided by net income.
kpis.description: Payout ratio = Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Dividend cut risk, monitor payout sustainability
